name: @cmu-sei/sds-site-generator
description: A Markdown-first static documentation site generator with SDS Lite

scripts.dev: npm run build:generator && node scripts/cli.mjs preview docs-site
scripts.build: npm run build:generator && node scripts/cli.mjs build docs-site
scripts.check: npm run build:generator && node scripts/cli.mjs check docs-site --strict
scripts.test: npm run build:generator && npm run test:generator && npm run test:package
